name: game-modding-toolkit
description: Create and improve games and visually rich apps with asset generation, conversion, code analysis and verified integration.

interface.longDescription: Create and improve games and visually rich apps with asset generation, conversion, code analysis and verified integration. Includes universal-modder, REA, Ghidra, ILSpy and AssetStudio on Windows and Docker. Fal generation requires an API key; 3D rendering requires Blender.
defaultPrompt: Create a playable game prototype and prepare its visual assets.
Improve this app with consistent icons, illustrations and animations.
Modify this project, integrate its assets and verify the result.
